mapper.insert: INSERT INTO color_hunter_score (user_id, best_final_time, best_actual_time, lowest_error_count, fastest_round, achieved_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bestFinalTime}, #{bestActualTime}, #{lowestErrorCount}, #{fastestRound}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE color_hunter_score SET best_final_time = LEAST(best_final_time, #{dto.bestFinalTime}), best_actual_time = CASE WHEN #{dto.bestActualTime} IS NOT NULL AND (best_actual_time IS NULL OR #{dto.bestActualTime} < best_actual_time) THEN #{dto.bestActualTime} ELSE best_actual_time END, lowest_error_count = CASE WHEN #{dto.lowestErrorCount} IS NOT NULL AND (lowest_error_count IS NULL OR #{dto.lowestErrorCount} < lowest_error_count) THEN #{dto.lowestErrorCount} ELSE lowest_error_count END, fastest_round = CASE WHEN #{dto.fastestRound} IS NOT NULL AND (fastest_round IS NULL OR #{dto.fastestRound} < fastest_round) THEN #{dto.fastestRound} ELSE fastest_round END, achieved_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.best_final_time AS bestFinalTime, u.nickname AS nickname FROM color_hunter_score s LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = s.user_id ORDER BY s.best_final_time ASC, s.achieved_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
